revisions.text: Your brilliance has gotten you far in life, but you have enough humility to know there are some things beyond even your considerable ability. Summon me, Calico, and together we will do great things.

Your brillance has gotten you far in life, but you have enough humility to know there are some things beyond even your considerable ability.  Complete the ritual Calico… and together with The Hidden King, do great things.
